approval.basis: Owner explicitly directed the complete Ask Bill architecture and PR plan (16 October 2026) and installation of foundational commit.

units.title: Repository binding and canonical plan
scope: Bind the verified GitHub repository identity; install this architecture and all 112 units in the existing shared registry contract; retain evidence policy and stable IDs.
units.acceptanceCriteria: The canonical registry has exactly 112 unique units, no invented PR mappings, and no active alternative roadmap.
verification: Run the shared parser, cycle and dependency checks, and compare every unit with this plan; test that a changed repository identity is rejected.
units.rollback: Restore prior planning files without discarding any approved scope or real PR evidence.
units.acceptance: The canonical registry has exactly 112 unique units, no invented PR mappings, and no active alternative roadmap.

source.heading: AB-001 Repository binding and canonical plan

units.title: Toolchain workspace and CircleCI
scope: Create the TypeScript monorepo, pinned Node and pnpm versions, lint, types, unit checks, build jobs and dependency cache.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A fresh checkout builds repeatably; required checks fail on an intentional defect; no accidental GitHub Actions build competes with CircleCI.
verification: Run the cold-install pipeline and deliberate type-error negative test on a disposable branch; retain head-bound CI IDs.
units.rollback: Revert workspace changes and preserve the registry plus reproducible toolchain manifest.
units.acceptance: A fresh checkout builds repeatably; required checks fail on an intentional defect; no accidental GitHub Actions build competes with CircleCI.

source.heading: AB-002 Toolchain workspace and CircleCI

units.title: Runtime contracts and architecture decisions
scope: Implement schemas for versions, spans, answer claims, events, cues, roles and asset manifests; document source and presentation trust boundaries.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Invalid source spans, unknown cue types and wrong-version events are rejected by server and client contract tests.
verification: Round-trip valid fixtures and fuzz unknown fields, Unicode boundaries, oversize inputs and incompatible schema versions.
units.rollback: Pin consumers to the prior contract version and reject incompatible messages.
units.acceptance: Invalid source spans, unknown cue types and wrong-version events are rejected by server and client contract tests.

source.heading: AB-003 Runtime contracts and architecture decisions

units.title: Accessible product shell and design tokens
scope: Build bill picker, readable page, conversation panel, character dock, source drawer, mobile sheet and all loading or empty states.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Keyboard order and semantic structure work before graphics or live AI; 320 CSS pixel width and large text remain usable.
verification: Run keyboard and axe checks plus responsive screenshots of every core state; test failed JavaScript hydration.
units.rollback: Keep the semantic reader and disable incomplete interactive panels through a feature flag.
units.acceptance: Keyboard order and semantic structure work before graphics or live AI; 320 CSS pixel width and large text remain usable.

source.heading: AB-004 Accessible product shell and design tokens

units.title: Environment adapters and local development
scope: Define validated environment configuration, fake provider adapters, local database and storage, sample data and one documented startup command.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Missing production credentials produce named capability errors while local reading, fake AI and asset development remain usable.
verification: Start from a clean machine profile and verify secrets never enter client bundles or committed examples.
units.rollback: Disable affected live adapters and keep local fixture mode working.
units.acceptance: Missing production credentials produce named capability errors while local reading, fake AI and asset development remain usable.

source.heading: AB-005 Environment adapters and local development

units.title: Binary asset ownership and reproducibility
scope: Select Git LFS or versioned asset storage; record editable source paths, hashes, license fields, generated outputs and fetch tooling.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A clean checkout can obtain exact authorized source assets; missing pointers or mismatched hashes fail the build.
verification: Delete cached assets, re-fetch a test source, validate hashes and verify an intentionally broken pointer is detected.
units.rollback: Restore the previous asset manifest and keep old immutable runtime assets available.
units.acceptance: A clean checkout can obtain exact authorized source assets; missing pointers or mismatched hashes fail the build.

source.heading: AB-006 Binary asset ownership and reproducibility

units.title: Database schema migrations and access boundaries
scope: Create bill, version, provision, publisher, session, job, outbox, usage and audit tables with scoped keys and retention indexes.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Foreign keys and publisher-scoped queries prevent cross-publisher reads; migrations are repeatable and backward compatible.
verification: Migrate an empty and populated database, test authorization on guessed IDs, and exercise expand then rollback compatibility.
units.rollback: Roll back application code to the compatible schema; avoid destructive down migrations.
units.acceptance: Foreign keys and publisher-scoped queries prevent cross-publisher reads; migrations are repeatable and backward compatible.

source.heading: AB-007 Database schema migrations and access boundaries

units.title: Publisher authentication roles and MFA
scope: Implement an adapter-backed publisher login, owner/editor/viewer roles, secure sessions, MFA for publication and protected membership changes.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated and wrong-role users cannot upload, publish, withdraw or invite; public reading has no login wall.
verification: Run CSRF, expired-session, privilege-escalation, role-change and MFA recovery tests using a real staging auth adapter when configured.
units.rollback: Revoke affected sessions and disable publisher writes while retaining published read access.
units.acceptance: Unauthenticated and wrong-role users cannot upload, publish, withdraw or invite; public reading has no login wall.

source.heading: AB-008 Publisher authentication roles and MFA

units.title: Object storage signed access and manifests
scope: Separate private quarantine, private source and public immutable artifacts; add bounded signed uploads and downloads, checksum checks and CORS rules.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Private bytes cannot be fetched through public URLs; signed tokens expire and bind to the allowed object and size.
verification: Test unauthorized object enumeration, replay, MIME spoofing, corrupt upload and expiration with the staging storage adapter.
units.rollback: Revoke upload capability and restore prior published manifests; keep immutable objects unchanged.
units.acceptance: Private bytes cannot be fetched through public URLs; signed tokens expire and bind to the allowed object and size.

source.heading: AB-009 Object storage signed access and manifests

units.title: Durable jobs outbox and fencing
scope: Build PostgreSQL leases, heartbeats, deduplication, retry and dead-letter states, transactional outbox delivery and fenced commits.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Crashed workers do not double-publish; stale lease holders cannot commit; failed jobs have actionable diagnostics.
verification: Kill a worker mid-job, deliver duplicate outbox events and race two lease owners against the same record.
units.rollback: Pause the queue and replay durable uncommitted jobs with the previous compatible worker.
units.acceptance: Crashed workers do not double-publish; stale lease holders cannot commit; failed jobs have actionable diagnostics.

source.heading: AB-010 Durable jobs outbox and fencing

units.title: Threat model and privacy inventory
scope: Enumerate source injection, file parsing, publisher isolation, cost abuse, child data, model tools and all provider data flows; assign concrete mitigations.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Every sensitive flow has an owner module, retention rule and verification case; no outside human-audit prerequisite is introduced.
verification: Trace a question, microphone request, upload and publish through the inventory; verify secrets and personal content are excluded from standard logs.
units.rollback: Disable an uncovered data flow until its concrete controls are implemented.
units.acceptance: Every sensitive flow has an owner module, retention rule and verification case; no outside human-audit prerequisite is introduced.

source.heading: AB-011 Threat model and privacy inventory

units.title: Preview infrastructure and health signals
scope: Define isolated local, preview and staging services with secret references, migration sequencing, readiness, liveness and worker drain behavior.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Preview cannot reach production secrets or data; deployments expose meaningful build and schema versions.
verification: Deploy staging when credentials exist, interrupt shutdown, and verify readiness fails for missing mandatory dependencies.
units.rollback: Revert to the previous service image and version-compatible database schema.
units.acceptance: Preview cannot reach production secrets or data; deployments expose meaningful build and schema versions.

source.heading: AB-012 Preview infrastructure and health signals

units.title: Provenance and immutable source records
scope: Store original bytes, source URL, retrieval time, publisher identity, byte hash and canonicalization version; make each import immutable.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A source record can be traced back to exact bytes; re-import never silently overwrites a published version.
verification: Import identical and changed bytes twice and verify deduplication, provenance links and immutable version boundaries.
units.rollback: Withdraw the new import pointer and preserve prior source records.
units.acceptance: A source record can be traced back to exact bytes; re-import never silently overwrites a published version.

source.heading: AB-013 Provenance and immutable source records

units.title: Upload quarantine and extraction sandbox
scope: Implement file signature checks, archive expansion limits, malware hooks, network-denied extraction and per-job CPU, memory and time budgets.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Macros, XXE, zip bombs, active objects and remote-resource fetches cannot execute or escape extraction.
verification: Run malicious PDF/DOCX/XML fixtures, oversized archives and timeouts; verify no production credential exists in the sandbox.
units.rollback: Stop extraction jobs and retain isolated quarantine metadata for investigation.
units.acceptance: Macros, XXE, zip bombs, active objects and remote-resource fetches cannot execute or escape extraction.

source.heading: AB-014 Upload quarantine and extraction sandbox

units.title: Text Markdown and DOCX ingestion
scope: Extract exact text, nested headings, lists, footnotes and tables from supported text, Markdown and DOCX files without executing embedded content.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Canonical text preserves substantive wording and source locators; parse warnings are visible and do not auto-correct language.
verification: Compare fixture extractions with golden source text including smart quotes, symbols, tables and tracked-change handling.
units.rollback: Revert parser version and rebuild only affected unpublished derivations.
units.acceptance: Canonical text preserves substantive wording and source locators; parse warnings are visible and do not auto-correct language.

source.heading: AB-015 Text Markdown and DOCX ingestion

units.title: PDF extraction and OCR quality workflow
scope: Add native PDF text, scan detection, bounded OCR, page thumbnails and confidence or missing-page warnings with correction tools.
units.acceptanceCriteria: An incomplete scan cannot become an authoritative published pack; source pages remain inspectable alongside extracted text.
verification: Use multicolumn, scanned, rotated, missing-page and low-resolution fixtures; verify exact quotations against page evidence.
units.rollback: Quarantine affected versions and restore a prior verified extraction generation.
units.acceptance: An incomplete scan cannot become an authoritative published pack; source pages remain inspectable alongside extracted text.

source.heading: AB-016 PDF extraction and OCR quality workflow

units.title: Legislative XML parser and hierarchy
scope: Support the selected official federal XML dialect; normalize nested legislative units while preserving original identifiers and unknown structures.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Deep nesting and unusual labels retain exact text and stable hierarchy; unsupported tags produce explicit warnings.
verification: Parse real official XML samples and hostile entities; compare reconstructed order and span boundaries against sources.
units.rollback: Fall back to a labeled source-text preview and disable affected structured publication.
units.acceptance: Deep nesting and unusual labels retain exact text and stable hierarchy; unsupported tags produce explicit warnings.

source.heading: AB-017 Legislative XML parser and hierarchy

units.title: Provision anchors Unicode and source spans
scope: Generate version-specific provision anchors, code-point offsets, source locators and quote hashes; implement UTF-16 boundary conversion in browsers.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A citation selects identical wording in storage and DOM even with emoji, combining characters, ligatures and normalized whitespace.
verification: Round-trip span fixtures and property-test random Unicode strings and invalid ranges.
units.rollback: Reject incompatible spans and keep original-source links available.
units.acceptance: A citation selects identical wording in storage and DOM even with emoji, combining characters, ligatures and normalized whitespace.

source.heading: AB-018 Provision anchors Unicode and source spans

units.title: Definitions cross references and exceptions
scope: Extract scoped definitions, internal and external references, exceptions, timing clauses and unresolved links into a typed relation graph.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Retrieval can follow controlling definitions and exceptions; ambiguous links are visible rather than guessed.
verification: Resolve hand-labeled complex references and verify no exception is dropped in designated fixtures.
units.rollback: Remove the affected graph generation and use explicit provision retrieval.
units.acceptance: Retrieval can follow controlling definitions and exceptions; ambiguous links are visible rather than guessed.

source.heading: AB-019 Definitions cross references and exceptions

units.title: Official Congress source connector
scope: Import bill identity, text versions and status from documented official APIs; implement rate limits, retries, ETags and provenance.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A selected official version can be re-imported reproducibly and has no fabricated identifier or status.
verification: Run fixture tests plus a live staging import when an API credential is available; compare API records with published source metadata.
units.rollback: Pause the connector and display the last verified refresh date.
units.acceptance: A selected official version can be re-imported reproducibly and has no fabricated identifier or status.

source.heading: AB-020 Official Congress source connector

units.title: Version lifecycle status and freshness
scope: Implement draft, introduced, passed, enacted and effective status evidence; immutable versions, stale-source banners and explicit version switching.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Enacted and effective states remain distinct; an old conversation never silently follows a newer version.
verification: Change a fixture's status and text independently and verify pinned answers and visible freshness behavior.
units.rollback: Pin public pointers to the last verified release and disable the refresh job.
units.acceptance: Enacted and effective states remain distinct; an old conversation never silently follows a newer version.

source.heading: AB-021 Version lifecycle status and freshness

units.title: Amendments and computed comparison view
scope: Represent insert, strike, replace, repeal and redesignation with citations; build before/after views and conflict reporting.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Computed amended text is labeled; ambiguous amendments cannot produce an authoritative combined document.
verification: Apply and reject golden amendment fixtures, including shifted numbering and conflicting edits.
units.rollback: Disable computed comparisons and preserve the original texts side by side.
units.acceptance: Computed amended text is labeled; ambiguous amendments cannot produce an authoritative combined document.

source.heading: AB-022 Amendments and computed comparison view

units.title: Lexical search and derived index generations
scope: Build provision full-text indexes and scoped search with complete index-generation hashes and atomic activation.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Search returns the selected bill version only; a failed index job cannot replace a complete published index.
verification: Query definitions, exact phrases and removed clauses across versions, then interrupt an index activation.
units.rollback: Restore the previous complete index-generation pointer.
units.acceptance: Search returns the selected bill version only; a failed index job cannot replace a complete published index.

source.heading: AB-023 Lexical search and derived index generations

units.title: Publishing review and immutable release packs
scope: Build extraction review, source-bound QA records, evaluated release manifests, atomic publish, archive and withdraw actions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Only permitted publishers publish complete verified packs; readers never see half-built files or stale related indexes.
verification: Fail publication after object upload but before pointer activation, race concurrent publishers and verify withdrawal cache invalidation.
units.rollback: Withdraw the faulty release and atomically reactivate the previous compatible manifest.
units.acceptance: Only permitted publishers publish complete verified packs; readers never see half-built files or stale related indexes.

source.heading: AB-024 Publishing review and immutable release packs

units.title: Electronic filing reference pack
scope: Preserve exact supplied passages with incomplete-source metadata; ingest the full chosen draft when available; author questions about receipt, routing, correction and denials.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Supplied excerpts work as fixtures but cannot be labeled the full bill; final public pack requires a complete source and status review.
verification: Verify original-receipt and wrong-agency questions against exact supplied wording; test missing definitions and omitted opening sections.
units.rollback: Keep the incomplete fixture private and publish no invented reconstruction.
units.acceptance: Supplied excerpts work as fixtures but cannot be labeled the full bill; final public pack requires a complete source and status review.

source.heading: AB-025 Electronic filing reference pack

units.title: Additional bill fixtures and large document cases
scope: Add at least two official bills of different structure plus a very long synthetic stress document clearly labeled as synthetic.
units.acceptanceCriteria: The platform is reusable beyond the first bill and handles nested definitions, amendments and long navigation without special hard-coded logic.
verification: Re-run extraction, anchors, search and page navigation against all packs; verify source licenses and provenance.
units.rollback: Unpublish the affected pack while retaining the functioning reference corpus.
units.acceptance: The platform is reusable beyond the first bill and handles nested definitions, amendments and long navigation without special hard-coded logic.

source.heading: AB-026 Additional bill fixtures and large document cases

units.title: Publisher source correction and audit history
scope: Provide visible extraction corrections, new-version creation, source comparison and signed-in actor audit trails without silent source replacement.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A correction invalidates dependent drafts and preserves prior published evidence and version URLs.
verification: Correct one character in a cited passage and verify new hashes, invalidated answers and retained old source access.
units.rollback: Withdraw the corrected version and restore its prior release pointer.
units.acceptance: A correction invalidates dependent drafts and preserves prior published evidence and version URLs.

source.heading: AB-027 Publisher source correction and audit history

units.title: Content gate and ingestion failure recovery
scope: Complete the ingestion and publication runbook, retry tooling, dead-letter review and source-integrity gate for all supported formats.
units.acceptanceCriteria: The content pipeline passes exactness and isolation checks and can recover a failed job without duplicate publication.
verification: Execute the full import-to-publish flow with a worker crash, corrupted source, unavailable API and withdrawn release.
units.rollback: Disable intake independently from public reading and restore the last complete content release.
units.acceptance: The content pipeline passes exactness and isolation checks and can recover a failed job without duplicate publication.

source.heading: AB-028 Content gate and ingestion failure recovery

units.title: Question routing and source permissions
scope: Classify question type and permitted scope; keep bill interpretation, current law, hypothetical and personal application distinct.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Each request has a version-pinned allowed corpus and cannot select another publisher's private sources.
verification: Test misleading question labels, prompt injection and forged publisher or version IDs.
units.rollback: Return curated source explanations and disable affected routing classes.
units.acceptance: Each request has a version-pinned allowed corpus and cannot select another publisher's private sources.

source.heading: AB-029 Question routing and source permissions

units.title: Provider adapters capability checks and cancellation
scope: Implement structured-generation adapters, deterministic fake provider, capability discovery, timeouts, abort and normalized provider errors.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Provider changes do not alter the public answer schema; cancellation reaches the upstream call and old output is ignored.
verification: Exercise a fake stream and one configured live provider with timeout, malformed JSON, cancellation and retry cases.
units.rollback: Disable the failing provider and retain curated responses plus readable sources.
units.acceptance: Provider changes do not alter the public answer schema; cancellation reaches the upstream call and old output is ignored.

source.heading: AB-030 Provider adapters capability checks and cancellation

units.title: Evidence retrieval and dependency expansion
scope: Combine lexical retrieval, parent/child expansion, definitions, exceptions and timing clauses; benchmark optional vector retrieval before enabling it.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Must-pass evidence sets include decisive exceptions and exclude wrong versions or private documents.
verification: Measure recall on labeled questions and deliberately adversarial near-duplicate provisions; compare vector and lexical-only baselines.
units.rollback: Revert to the strongest evaluated retrieval configuration and index generation.
units.acceptance: Must-pass evidence sets include decisive exceptions and exclude wrong versions or private documents.

source.heading: AB-031 Evidence retrieval and dependency expansion

units.title: Claim envelope and exact citation validation
scope: Implement typed claims, exact source spans, permitted evidence IDs, quote hashes and source links; reject invented citations deterministically.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Every accepted legal-text citation resolves to exact wording in the selected version; unsupported claim types cannot masquerade as bill text.
verification: Mutate span offsets, quote text, source version and citation URLs and require rejection.
units.rollback: Suppress invalid answer segments and show a source-only recovery response.
units.acceptance: Every accepted legal-text citation resolves to exact wording in the selected version; unsupported claim types cannot masquerade as bill text.

source.heading: AB-032 Claim envelope and exact citation validation

units.title: Support checks exception preservation and repair
scope: Add evidence entailment review, decisive-exception checks, bounded repair and supported partial answers with explicit uncertainty.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Unsupported predictions and omitted decisive exceptions cannot pass the must-pass set; repair never loops indefinitely.
verification: Run contradictory evidence, incomplete source and misleading premise cases with held-out assessments.
units.rollback: Disable the changed prompt or validator and restore its prior evaluated release.
units.acceptance: Unsupported predictions and omitted decisive exceptions cannot pass the must-pass set; repair never loops indefinitely.

source.heading: AB-033 Support checks exception preservation and repair

units.title: Anonymous sessions quotas and usage ledger
scope: Implement short-lived capabilities, transactionally reserved budgets, idempotent settlement, expiry and global generation ceilings.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate requests charge once; concurrent calls cannot bypass limits; public reading survives a generation shutdown.
verification: Race budget reservations, abort upstream requests, replay idempotency keys and test provider billing reconciliation.
units.rollback: Stop new live generations while preserving reading and completed answers.
units.acceptance: Duplicate requests charge once; concurrent calls cannot bypass limits; public reading survives a generation shutdown.

source.heading: AB-034 Anonymous sessions quotas and usage ledger

units.title: Validated answer streaming and replay
scope: Emit approved segments over sequenced SSE with bounded replay, Last-Event-ID, conversation epochs and cancellation.
units.acceptanceCriteria: No raw model token reaches the visitor; late or wrong-version events cannot revive cancelled text, speech or cues.
verification: Disconnect and reconnect mid-answer, replay old event IDs, reorder events and switch document versions while generation runs.
units.rollback: Use whole-answer validation and nonstreaming delivery until streaming passes.
units.acceptance: No raw model token reaches the visitor; late or wrong-version events cannot revive cancelled text, speech or cues.

source.heading: AB-035 Validated answer streaming and replay

units.title: Citation cards source drawer and answer states
scope: Render claim labels, source quotes, uncertainty, partial and correction states with reliable return navigation.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Visitors can inspect every claim's exact source without Bill, audio or a graphics context.
verification: Navigate all citation types by keyboard and screen reader and test unresolved or withdrawn spans.
units.rollback: Show a plain answer transcript and original-source links.
units.acceptance: Visitors can inspect every claim's exact source without Bill, audio or a graphics context.

source.heading: AB-036 Citation cards source drawer and answer states

units.title: Current law background and as of comparisons
scope: Add approved primary-source imports for existing law and dated side-by-side comparisons; keep background apart from draft assertions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: An unsupported statement about current law is withheld; jurisdiction and retrieval dates accompany supported comparisons.
verification: Test a draft that misdescribes existing law and source updates that invalidate an old comparison.
units.rollback: Disable live comparisons and retain bill-only explanations.
units.acceptance: An unsupported statement about current law is withheld; jurisdiction and retrieval dates accompany supported comparisons.

source.heading: AB-037 Current law background and as of comparisons

units.title: Prompt injection and hostile question defenses
scope: Harden source delimiters, read-tool allowlists, safe component rendering and refusal of model-supplied execution or secret requests.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Malicious bill text cannot run code, leak a secret, change the corpus or emit active HTML.
verification: Attack uploaded text, retrieved snippets, conversation history, markdown links and forged tool outputs.
units.rollback: Disable affected tools or content packs and use source-only explanations.
units.acceptance: Malicious bill text cannot run code, leak a secret, change the corpus or emit active HTML.

source.heading: AB-038 Prompt injection and hostile question defenses

units.title: Objections disputed readings and unknown answers
scope: Implement attributed objections, competing interpretations, implementation limits and direct unknown states without forced certainty.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Sponsor arguments are labeled, important objections are discoverable and unsupported cost predictions are not invented.
verification: Evaluate leading pro and anti questions against identical evidence and inspect material differences in treatment.
units.rollback: Replace affected generated answers with curated balanced source cards.
units.acceptance: Sponsor arguments are labeled, important objections are discoverable and unsupported cost predictions are not invented.

source.heading: AB-039 Objections disputed readings and unknown answers

units.title: Evaluation corpus scoring and held out suite
scope: Create at least 240 cases with at least 80 adversarial or ambiguous cases; label evidence, exceptions, status and unsupported conclusions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Held-out cases are separated from tuning; score reports identify exact model, prompts, sources and validator hashes.
verification: Run citation, recall, support and status scoring with spot-checked annotations and known deliberately bad answers.
units.rollback: Block the regressed model configuration and retain the last passing evaluation baseline.
units.acceptance: Held-out cases are separated from tuning; score reports identify exact model, prompts, sources and validator hashes.

source.heading: AB-040 Evaluation corpus scoring and held out suite

units.title: Reading levels explanations and privacy defaults
scope: Add concise, standard and simple explanations that preserve legal conditions; default to ephemeral history and minimal data collection.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Simpler wording retains decisive exceptions; no reading preference is used as a claim about the visitor's age.
verification: Compare all reading levels on the same exception-heavy questions and inspect retained request fields.
units.rollback: Restore standard explanations and remove any persisted preference not covered by policy.
units.acceptance: Simpler wording retains decisive exceptions; no reading preference is used as a claim about the visitor's age.

source.heading: AB-041 Reading levels explanations and privacy defaults

units.title: Public answer caching provider fallback and budgets
scope: Cache only approved public nonpersonal responses by complete configuration key; add circuit breakers and a readable degraded mode.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Version changes and validator fixes invalidate the right entries; personal or session content never enters a shared cache.
verification: Mix personal and public questions, change corpus hashes, force provider errors and exhaust budgets during traffic.
units.rollback: Purge affected cache keys and fall back to curated answers.
units.acceptance: Version changes and validator fixes invalidate the right entries; personal or session content never enters a shared cache.

source.heading: AB-042 Public answer caching provider fallback and budgets

units.title: Answer feedback corrections and incident controls
scope: Add explicit redacted feedback submission, answer-template suppression, visible corrections and source-bound incident records.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A reported defect can be disabled without deleting audit evidence or exposing private user conversation.
verification: Submit redacted feedback, suppress an answer hash, apply a correction and verify old shared references show the correction.
units.rollback: Disable the affected answer or pack and keep public source access available.
units.acceptance: A reported defect can be disabled without deleting audit evidence or exposing private user conversation.

source.heading: AB-043 Answer feedback corrections and incident controls

units.title: Grounded conversation acceptance gate
scope: Run live-provider staging evaluation and end-to-end question-to-source checks; fix actual unsupported claims and retain evidence.
units.acceptanceCriteria: All must-pass cases satisfy source integrity and status rules; broader support target is met with no unresolved serious legal misstatements.
verification: Run the held-out suite, outages, quota exhaustion and personal-case tests against the exact release candidate.
units.rollback: Pin the previous passing configuration or disable live AI while reading and curated tours continue.
units.acceptance: All must-pass cases satisfy source integrity and status rules; broader support target is met with no unresolved serious legal misstatements.

source.heading: AB-044 Grounded conversation acceptance gate

units.title: Original character brief and provenance
scope: Write the Folded Folio design bible, originality constraints, personality, proportions, palette, expression vocabulary and source-provenance ledger.
units.acceptanceCriteria: The character is independently specified in shape, face, costume, voice and gestures; no copied seal, song or signature design is required.
verification: Compare silhouette and expression references against the originality checklist and document distinct design decisions.
units.rollback: Retain the brief and replace an overly similar design direction before production.
units.acceptance: The character is independently specified in shape, face, costume, voice and gestures; no copied seal, song or signature design is required.

source.heading: AB-045 Original character brief and provenance

units.title: Concept candidates and selected design
scope: Produce three materially distinct original candidates, turnarounds, silhouettes and expression studies; select one through documented visual review.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A selected design reads clearly at mobile scale and has front, side, back and three-quarter references sufficient for modeling.
verification: Render monochrome and 96-pixel comparisons and inspect legibility, appeal, uniqueness and facial range.
units.rollback: Preserve the candidate set and switch the selected design manifest without losing provenance.
units.acceptance: A selected design reads clearly at mobile scale and has front, side, back and three-quarter references sufficient for modeling.

source.heading: AB-046 Concept candidates and selected design

units.title: Parametric Blender blockout
scope: Build a scriptable body, folds, layered pages, arms, hands, eyes and feet with measured proportions and scene units.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A clean Blender batch run recreates the selected blockout with named editable objects and stable scale.
verification: Rebuild from a clean scene, compare turntable views with references and inspect contact-plane and origin alignment.
units.rollback: Revert the blockout parameter set and keep downstream assets tied to its source hash.
units.acceptance: A clean Blender batch run recreates the selected blockout with named editable objects and stable scale.

source.heading: AB-047 Parametric Blender blockout

units.title: Production topology and deformation mesh
scope: Refine face, folds, joints and limbs with deformation-ready topology, clean normals, UV seams and separate material regions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Stress poses do not collapse page edges, eyelids, hands or knees; no unintended holes or nonmanifold geometry remain.
verification: Run geometry audits and render bent-limb, compressed-body and extreme-expression pose tests.
units.rollback: Restore the last clean mesh and regenerate dependent exports.
units.acceptance: Stress poses do not collapse page edges, eyelids, hands or knees; no unintended holes or nonmanifold geometry remain.

source.heading: AB-048 Production topology and deformation mesh

units.title: UV layout high detail bake and textures
scope: Author UV atlases and original paper, edge, roughness, normal and color detail; bake high-resolution detail to runtime meshes.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Textures have no visible seam or excessive shimmer and preserve readable face features at small size.
verification: Render close and thumbnail views under varied lighting and inspect mip transitions, UV density and color spaces.
units.rollback: Restore previous texture sources and rebake all derived atlases.
units.acceptance: Textures have no visible seam or excessive shimmer and preserve readable face features at small size.

source.heading: AB-049 UV layout high detail bake and textures

units.title: Body skeleton control rig and export bones
scope: Implement body and fold controls, arm IK/FK, foot IK, sockets, look targets, contact-plane origin and documented rest pose.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Animators can pose every required action; only expected deforming bones are exported and transforms are stable.
verification: Run automated bone and weight checks, mirrored poses and extreme limb stress renders.
units.rollback: Restore the prior rig and retain animation sources for retargeting.
units.acceptance: Animators can pose every required action; only expected deforming bones are exported and transforms are stable.

source.heading: AB-050 Body skeleton control rig and export bones

units.title: Facial shapes expressions and correctives
scope: Sculpt expression controls, blinks, brows, jaw and 12 to 16 speech mouth shapes with corrective combinations.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Curiosity, concern, thinking and uncertainty are distinguishable at 96 pixels; combined mouth and blink weights do not break the face.
verification: Render a morph grid, phoneme extremes and random bounded combinations; inspect silhouette and intersections.

units.title: Material look development and lighting bible

verification: Render the same poses across bright, dark and high-contrast backgrounds and inspect texture and shadow readability.

verification: Render a gesture contact sheet and interrupted-transition sequence; inspect hands, face and contact points.

units.acceptance: No known critical/high unresolved exploitable finding remains in released scope; review evidence is accurately labeled AI-assisted.

source.heading: AB-101 Security hardening dependency review and AI audit

units.title: Performance load and cost qualification
scope: Measure web vitals, frame times, memory, answer latency, queue depth, traffic scenario and spend ceilings using selected live providers.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Target budgets pass or have an explicit measured scope decision; limits stop cost overruns without breaking reading.
verification: Run 1,000-reader/25-generation scenarios within approved spend caps and test enforced ceilings and graceful degradation.
units.rollback: Reduce active generation concurrency and graphics tiers while fixing measured bottlenecks.
units.acceptance: Target budgets pass or have an explicit measured scope decision; limits stop cost overruns without breaking reading.

source.heading: AB-102 Performance load and cost qualification

units.title: Operational telemetry alerts and diagnostics
scope: Deploy privacy-minimized metrics, source freshness and budget alerts, graphics failure rates, queue age and retention backlog diagnostics.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Alerts identify concrete failures without raw questions, microphone bytes, secrets or political profiling.
verification: Inject provider outage, stale source, dead-letter job and quota ceiling and verify actual alert delivery in staging.
units.rollback: Disable the problematic telemetry field and retain essential aggregate health signals.
units.acceptance: Alerts identify concrete failures without raw questions, microphone bytes, secrets or political profiling.

source.heading: AB-103 Operational telemetry alerts and diagnostics

units.title: Backup restore disaster recovery and incident drills
scope: Configure encrypted backups and restore procedures, source and asset reconstruction, key rotation and deletion replay; run incident drills.
units.acceptanceCriteria: The demonstrated restore meets the initial RPO/RTO objectives and preserves source hashes and publisher access boundaries.
verification: Restore to isolated staging, simulate a lost asset pointer and revoke a compromised credential; retain drill timings.
units.rollback: Stop writes and restore the last known good compatible release and database snapshot.
units.acceptance: The demonstrated restore meets the initial RPO/RTO objectives and preserves source hashes and publisher access boundaries.

source.heading: AB-104 Backup restore disaster recovery and incident drills

units.title: Production service configuration and secret readiness
scope: Finalize Render service and worker configuration, Neon connection limits, private buckets, provider keys, migrations, health checks and graceful rollout.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Configuration names each required secret and has no embedded value; staging mirrors production boundaries and limits.
verification: Validate configuration and deploy the exact release candidate to staging, including worker drain and migration failure recovery.
units.rollback: Redeploy the prior service image and restore its release manifest.
units.acceptance: Configuration names each required secret and has no embedded value; staging mirrors production boundaries and limits.

source.heading: AB-105 Production service configuration and secret readiness

units.title: Domain TLS identity and public policies
scope: Check the selected name and domain when implementing; configure DNS/TLS, publisher identity, privacy, accessibility, terms and correction-contact pages.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A verified chosen domain serves the correct release with valid TLS; policies match actual data flows and do not imply government affiliation.
verification: Verify redirect/certificate paths, security headers and each policy against network and retention evidence.
units.rollback: Use the existing verified staging hostname and remove unverified identity or domain claims.
units.acceptance: A verified chosen domain serves the correct release with valid TLS; policies match actual data flows and do not imply government affiliation.

source.heading: AB-106 Domain TLS identity and public policies

units.title: Live provider storage and deployment integration checks
scope: Verify real auth, LLM, TTS, STT, database, storage, CDN and hosting adapters with minimal authorized calls and exact build metadata.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Mock-only capabilities are clearly distinguished; every enabled production capability has a successful live evidence record.
verification: Run credentialed smoke tests, expired-key and quota errors, signed access and real file/audio round trips; redact secrets.
units.rollback: Disable the unverified adapter and keep a truthful degraded mode while other ready work continues.
units.acceptance: Mock-only capabilities are clearly distinguished; every enabled production capability has a successful live evidence record.

source.heading: AB-107 Live provider storage and deployment integration checks

units.title: Operator documentation and agent continuation kit
scope: Write runbooks, troubleshooting, source updates, character rebuild, provider replacement, release commands and evidence requirements; reconcile registry mappings.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A fresh agent can identify the exact build, reproduce checks, locate editable assets and select ready work without reading this conversation.
verification: Perform a clean-room continuation walkthrough from the documentation and verify every linked path and command exists.
units.rollback: Correct the documentation and keep the previous operational instructions available.
units.acceptance: A fresh agent can identify the exact build, reproduce checks, locate editable assets and select ready work without reading this conversation.

source.heading: AB-108 Operator documentation and agent continuation kit

units.title: Feature flags canary rollout and rollback rehearsal
scope: Add independent disable switches for live AI, voice, walking, uploads and publishing; rehearse canary and rollback on staging.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A bad model, source or graphics release can be removed without taking down readable bills; changes are observable and reversible.
verification: Trigger each switch under traffic and roll back a deliberately bad asset and answer configuration.
units.rollback: Revert to the prior manifest and disable the affected enhancement.
units.acceptance: A bad model, source or graphics release can be removed without taking down readable bills; changes are observable and reversible.

source.heading: AB-109 Feature flags canary rollout and rollback rehearsal

units.title: Content asset and release evidence reconciliation
scope: Audit all 112 unit records, actual PR mappings, source completeness, license files, content hashes and operational acceptance; fix discrepancies.
units.acceptanceCriteria: No placeholder, mock, stale CI result or missing source is counted as finished; unresolved inputs have exact names and affected capabilities.
verification: Run requirement coverage and evidence-link checks and compare the built manifests with the accepted source and asset sets.
units.rollback: Mark affected units incomplete and keep release pointers on the previous accepted build.
units.acceptance: No placeholder, mock, stale CI result or missing source is counted as finished; unresolved inputs have exact names and affected capabilities.

source.heading: AB-110 Content asset and release evidence reconciliation

units.title: Full release candidate soak and acceptance
scope: Run complete golden journeys, load/retention soak, cross-browser checks, restore confidence and an incident-response rehearsal on the exact candidate.
units.acceptanceCriteria: G8 has no unresolved required test failure, actual vulnerability, serious unsupported answer or missing enabled live integration evidence.
verification: Re-run only affected suites after fixes, record head/source/asset hashes and verify no stale events or growing resource leaks in the soak.
units.rollback: Reject the candidate, preserve findings and return to the last stable staging release.
units.acceptance: G8 has no unresolved required test failure, actual vulnerability, serious unsupported answer or missing enabled live integration evidence.

source.heading: AB-111 Full release candidate soak and acceptance

units.title: Production launch verification and final handoff
scope: Deploy within existing authorization, verify real public reading, citations, character, optional speech and privacy modes; reconcile actual PR state and acceptance separately.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Production serves the accepted build; smoke tests pass; all prior units have evidence and any disabled optional capability is stated explicitly.
verification: Check live routes, version hashes, TLS, source navigation, quota behavior and telemetry, then record rollback and continuation details.
units.rollback: Execute the rehearsed rollback immediately on failed smoke checks and keep the prior public release available.
units.acceptance: Production serves the accepted build; smoke tests pass; all prior units have evidence and any disabled optional capability is stated explicitly.

source.heading: AB-112 Production launch verification and final handoff
